description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between iteration number and loss for several different configurations. The x-axis is labeled “#Iteration” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140000, with tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. 

The first line, colored purple and labeled “Vanilla”, begins at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.55 by iteration 20000, then continues to decrease slowly to approximately 2.48 at iteration 140000. The second line, colored orange and labeled “StrmLLM (n=64)”, starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 20000, then continues to decrease slowly to approximately 2.49 at iteration 140000. The third line, colored orange and labeled “SepLLM (n=64)”, begins at approximately 3.25 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 20000, then remains relatively stable between approximately 2.51 and 2.53 for the remainder of the x-axis. The fourth line, colored green and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H)”, starts at approximately 3.25 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 20000, then remains relatively stable between approximately 2.51 and 2.53 for the remainder of the x-axis. The fifth line, colored magenta and labeled “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)”, begins at approximately 3.25 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 20000, then remains relatively stable between approximately 2.51 and 2.53 for the remainder of the x-axis. The sixth line, colored blue and labeled “SepLLM (n=128)”, starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to approximately 2.53 by iteration 20000, then remains relatively stable between approximately 2.51 and 2.53 for the remainder of the x-axis.
